Generated by `scripts/export_parity_fixtures.py` from the Python dashboard
logic and the committed `data/`. Don't edit by hand. Regenerate after
changing ported logic or refreshing `data/`:

    .venv/bin/python scripts/export_parity_fixtures.py

The script first snapshots its inputs into `data/` (sectors.json, and each
sector's signals.json and run_status.json, no archive) and `config/sectors/`
here, then computes every fixture from that snapshot. The parity tests therefore
don't depend on the live `data/`, which the pipeline rewrites several times a
day. Re-running the script refreshes the snapshot and the fixtures together.
